thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Prod inference errors spike on /v1/generate — 10:00 UTC — paging oncall @raj :rotating_light:

emma: got it, joining bridge now. any quick customer impact calc?

raj: joining — brief: increased 5xxs for hosted-region-usw2, some timeouts at 3000ms. customers A/B/C reported elevated error rates via support.

natalie: I'm already looking at infra metrics — looks like a backend mem leak on a specific task queue. rolling back last config push may help.

lee: CS here — we have 3 open zendesk tickets referencing "500 internal server error" and one Intercom thread with a dev on the phone. happy to send a blanket note if we have ETA.

emma: ok, quick internal comm plan: 1) short status to customers 2) triage + mitigation 3) handoff summary for next oncall. I'll draft macros.

raj: mitigation idea: disable batching on the problematic worker pool and restart — should reduce OOMs. doing `rbctl pool update workers-encoder --batching=false` now.

natalie: confirm logs show OOMs at 9:59:23 UTC repeatedly: 
```
[2026-03-10T09:59:23Z] worker-7 OOM killed, trace kv-cache size=18GB
[2026-03-10T09:59:24Z] task failed: ModelServeError: allocator OOM
```

emma: good. while we mitigate, prepare a short statuspage message: "We are investigating increased error rates affecting inference requests in US-WEST-2. Some requests may return 500 or timeout. Engineers are investigating; mitigation in progress." Keep it concise.

lee: suggested customer-facing macro for Zendesk: 
```
Hi — thanks for flagging this. We're aware of increased errors for inference in US-West-2 and our engineers are working on mitigation. You'll likely see reduced errors in ~15-30 minutes. I'll follow up here as we have an update. Sorry for the disruption. — Emma, Redwood Support
```

emma: save that as macro `incident/usw2-inference-500s`. Also Intercom quick reply: "We're investigating increased errors for generation requests in US-West-2. We're working on a fix and will update shortly."

raj: rollback attempt succeeded on worker pool and restarted 3 nodes. Monitoring for error rate drop.

natalie: metrics: 500-rate dropped from 12% -> 3% in 4m. latency still a bit elevated (p95 ~ 420ms). Looks promising.

emma: draft statuspage update v1: 
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: A subset of inference requests in US-West-2 may receive 500 errors or timeouts. We are applying mitigations.
Next update: in 20 minutes or when we have new info.
```

lee: I'll paste the Zendesk macro into the three open tickets and tag affected customers. Use placeholder for ETA where appropriate.

raj: checklist for handoff to next oncall (putting here so support has it): 
- what changed: rollback of `workers-encoder` batching flag at 10:02 UTC
- current symptoms: 500-rate ~3%, latency p95 420ms, KV-cache usage reduced
- mitigation applied: restarted 3 nodes, disabled batching on pool
- next steps: monitor for 30m, if 500s rebound -> re-evaluate model quantization/eviction policy
- runbook refs: /runbooks/inference/oom-and-kv-cache

natalie: add note: we saw a cache growth pattern tied to a specific 3rd-party client sending long prompts — tagging account `acct-423` for follow-up.

emma: support escalation macro (for when customers ask for root cause): 
```
Thanks for your patience. Root cause: temporary memory pressure in a worker pool handling batched inference requests, causing some requests to fail. Mitigation: disabled batching and restarted affected nodes. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up if you are impacted further. — Redwood Support
```

lee: I've sent the customer-facing macros; customers responded with :thumbsup: on two tickets.

raj: leaving handoff note in incident channel and linking this thread. Handoff summary for next oncall (natalie): watch OOM logs and kv-cache size, especially for tokens > 8k, and check batching flag state. If errors >5% for >10m escalate to eng-runtime.

natalie: ack, taking post-mitigation watch. Leaving my brief: turned on extra monitoring for `kv-cache-growth`, alert threshold set to 14GB.

emma: nice — final internal comm template for product & cs: 
```
Quick incident summary (to share internally): 10:00 UTC — Increased inference errors in US-WEST-2 due to memory pressure in a batched worker pool. Immediate mitigation: disabled batching and restarted workers; error rate reduced. Monitoring continues; customer notifications have been sent. Contact oncall @raj for technical questions or @emma for customer comms.
```

incident-bot: Incident updated — status changed to "Monitoring" at 10:12 UTC.

emma: closing loop here — will update tickets if anything changes, but macros are in draft and handoff notes live in the incident playbook. Thanks all. :heart:

lee: thanks team — filing follow-up tasks: ticket customers for long prompt guidance and schedule a postmortem if we hit rollback twice in a week.

natalie: adding postmortem placeholder.

raj: off-bridge, thx.

emma: thread archived into /support/incidents/1915002000 for knowledge base import.
